items.text:
Don't waste you money folks. I felt really ripped off.
Wow! The "artsy game" and "experiment in narrative" made me take the bait. I usually like that kind of games, like Dear Esther or Gone Home. But this... this is pure bullshit. I'm just glad that I bought it in a sale :P still the 20 or so minutes that took me to play it twice where not worth it :( Very disappointing.
I really was hopping for something meaningful.
Knowing that the "stages" where pre-scripted, I expected at least to have agency over the line of thoughts of the protagonist. After playing the game a second time I could confirm with 100% certainty that your actions have absolutely no effect over the monologue. Then what is the point anyway?
At first glance the visuals of the game look good. There seems to be some kind of art direction. But it falls very short at it's intent of realism. If the maker did not have the skills required to pull off that, a more stylized look would have been better. The plastic hands with a wrong shader make the experience more unsettling.
I guess that the interesting part of the game is supposed to be its narrative? Well, it sucks too. Basically, we all have passed to situations like this, nothing interesting happens. Step away from your screen, thing about what the fuck have you done with your like and you will have a better story in 2 seconds :P
items.text_zh:
别浪费钱了，各位。我真的觉得被坑了。
哇！那些“文艺游戏”和“叙事实验”让我上了钩。我通常喜欢那种游戏，比如《Dear Esther》或《Gone Home》。但这个……这纯粹是胡扯。我只是庆幸自己是在打折时买的 :P 即便如此，我玩了两次所花的20分钟左右时间也不值得 :( 非常令人失望。
我原本真的希望它能有些意义。
知道那些“阶段”是预先写好的，我至少期望能对主角的思路有自主权。在第二次玩过游戏后，我可以100%确定地确认，你的行为对独白绝对没有任何影响。那到底还有什么意义？
乍一看，游戏的视觉效果不错。似乎有某种艺术指导。但在追求现实主义方面却远远不够。如果制作者没有能力做到这一点，那么更风格化的外观会更好。塑料般的手配上错误的着色器，让体验更加令人不安。
我猜游戏的有趣部分应该是它的叙事？好吧，那也很烂。基本上，我们都经历过类似的情况，没有什么有趣的事情发生。从屏幕前走开，想想你他妈对自己的生活做了什么，你两秒钟内就能有一个更好的故事 :P

items.text:
DINNER DATE.
Stout Games, 2011

Genres: Casual, Indie, Sad Ass Simulator

Plot: The player assumes the role of Julian Luxemburg, a vaguely British man on a DINNER DATE with a beautiful Japanese woman.

Actually, that was a lie. You don’t assume the role of Julian Luxemburg, a vaguely British man on a date with a beautiful Japanese woman. You actually assume the role of Julian Luxemburg’s subconscious. And you’re actually being stood up by a beautiful Japanese woman. And you actually never see her, so she’s probably not that beautiful. Whether or not she’s even Japanese, I have my doubts.

Anyway, you “play” the game as Julian’s subconscious. What does that mean exactly? It means you don’t actually get full control of your character. Instead, you’re in charge of “the small unconscious actions we all do”--things like making Julian look at his hand, or look at his other hand, or touch his face. You do not, by the way, get to do any of the cool things a subconscious can do, like give Julian the sudden urge to kill or make him have a nightmare about his naked father. No, but you can make him mindlessly snack on a shitload of bread. And before you start to think that your actions can affect the outcome in the game whatsoever, you’re wrong. Nothing you do matters at all. You could do nothing or everything and nothing would change. To be fair, the game tells you this pretty much right away, so good on them.

So, you sit there for awhile doing random meaningless shit and Julian gets progressively drunker and more depressed as he rambles and whines on and on about his life as a total fucking loser and then, after 20 minutes of bullshit, he decides to leave his apartment and the game ends and you feel angry but also a little relieved that it’s over. The end.

Gameplay: What the game lacks in fun stuff, it makes up for in not fun stuff, such as stirring soup, looking at a clock, quoting Lord Byron, and constant whining.

Realism: As I said, you get stood up by your date and spend the evening getting drunk alone while succumbing to crippling doubt and insecurity. I don’t know what that’s like because I’m handsome. 0/10.

Graphics: I had the game set on “exorbitant graphical quality” but my character's fingers looked like mangled dongs.

Overall score: 3 out of 10 stars, which makes sense considering I paid 3 out of 10 dollars for the game.
items.text_zh:
晚餐约会。
Stout Games，2011

类型：休闲，独立，悲伤屁股模拟器

剧情：玩家扮演朱利安·卢森堡，一个 vaguely 英国男人，正与一位美丽的日本女人进行一场晚餐约会。

其实，那是谎言。你并不是扮演朱利安·卢森堡，一个 vaguely 英国男人，正与一位美丽的日本女人约会。你实际上扮演的是朱利安·卢森堡的潜意识。而你实际上是被一位美丽的日本女人放了鸽子。而且你实际上从未见过她，所以她可能没那么漂亮。她到底是不是日本人，我也持怀疑态度。

总之，你作为朱利安的潜意识来“玩”这个游戏。这到底是什么意思？意思是你实际上并不能完全控制你的角色。相反，你负责的是“我们所有人都会做的小的无意识动作”——比如让朱利安看看他的手，或者看看他的另一只手，或者摸摸他的脸。顺便说一句，你并不能做任何潜意识能做的酷事，比如让朱利安突然产生杀人的冲动，或者让他做关于自己裸体父亲的噩梦。不，但你可以让他无意识地狂吃一大堆面包。在你开始认为你的行为能以任何方式影响游戏结果之前，你错了。你做的任何事都完全不重要。你可以什么都不做，也可以做所有事，什么都不会改变。平心而论，游戏几乎立刻就告诉了你这一点，所以这点做得不错。

所以，你在那里坐一会儿，做些随机无意义的事，朱利安则越来越醉、越来越抑郁，他喋喋不休地抱怨自己作为一个彻头彻尾的失败者的生活，然后，在20分钟的胡扯之后，他决定离开他的公寓，游戏结束，你感到愤怒，但也因为结束了而有点松了口气。完。

玩法：游戏在有趣的东西上有所欠缺，却在不好玩的东西上弥补了回来，比如搅拌汤、看时钟、引用拜伦勋爵，以及不断的抱怨。

真实感：就像我说的，你被你的约会对象放了鸽子，然后独自一人喝醉，同时陷入严重的自我怀疑和不安。我不知道那是什么感觉，因为我很帅。0/10。

画面：我把游戏设成了“过高的图形质量”，但我角色的手指看起来像被扭烂的鸡巴。

总分：10星中得3星，考虑到我花了10美元中的3美元买这个游戏，这很合理。

observations.evidence: my character's fingers looked like mangled dongs
observations.evidence_zh: 我角色的手指看起来像被拧烂的鸡巴。

items.text:
The following paragraph is my recommendation for Painkiller: Black Edition, because, for some reason, Steam thinks I don't own that game, even though I fucking do. Like, I'm on the store page, and it doesn't even have that green section with the "play now" button. What the fuck. It's in my library. I bought the thing with money. Seriously, what the fuck.

Painkiller is a flawed game, but it is also hellishly fun. If you like fast-paced FPSs like Serious Sam, Doom or Quake, you'll dig this game. Big-ass levels with lots of variety, unique enemies and that special horror-y style. Also has unique guns, and all of them have alternate fires, like a shotgun that can freeze enemies or a sort of electric flamethrower... an electricitythrower... that shoots circular saw blade shuriken things! And you can click with both buttons to shoot one of the shuriken things that stays stuck to where it was fired while it is electrically charged and zaps multiple enemies around it. And a grenade launcher that is also a minigun. Hell yeah. Painkiller can be retarded hard and ridiculous sometimes, but it's just addictively fun. If it becomes too hard for you, you can just use cheats anyway. Sometimes it's funner that way too, just going kill crazy and blasting away like there's no tomorrow. The game also has some sort of... STORY. And a topless chick. Don't get the remake, Painkiller: Hell and Damnation, because they gave the topless chick a top. Fuck that. 0/10. Out of all the Painkillers to get into, the original right here should probably be your first choice.



The following paragraph is an anti-recommendation of Dinner Date, a shitty game that I CAN write a recommendation for, but is not the slightest bit recommendable.

Dinner Date is a boring piece of shit. It is hardly interactive at all, and what little possibility for player input there is is fucking lame and inconsequential; all you can do is look in specific directions and make your ugly seemingly-autistic hands touch things a little bit. Then there's a part where your character actually gets off the damn seat, but then it is still boring and there is still nothing to do but listen to this guy be a negative nansy about stupid shit you don't care about. You can't really do anything as the player because you play as the character's subconscious. Oooooooh... Interesting concept, but it turns out it is not fun at all. Your character got stood up for a date, and he is alone at a dinner table at his house, and all there is to do is listen to this guy whine and wallow in his patheticness. Interesting idea, bad game. And if you want to call it "interactive art" instead of a proper "video game", it fails in that department too. And the graphics suck too. I honestly was looking forward to this game, cause it was a fascinating idea, but the game just sucks. It honestly just sucks. This is a sucky game, and it's not worth any amount of time or money, except for maybe as an example of how NOT to make a game.

Dinner Date's top key feature on its store page reads as follows: "Julian’s story lasts a fully voiced 25 minutes and is told through various unique animations, set in a real-time 3d environment with the unique interface of playing as a subconsciousness, the first of its kind."

25 whole minutes? 25 whole minutes?! 25 WHOLE MINUTES?! 25 WHOLE MINUTES, MAN! 25 whole minutes of SHEEYIT. And then you'll flush that shit down the toilet and forget about it. Or at least try to, because that was pretty traumatizingly nasty and painful shit to take.

The icon for this recommendation shows that of Dinner Date, but this is really a recommendation for Painkiller, and a word of warning for whoever might actually consider buying Dinner Date. Don't do it; Dinner Date is not fun at all. It's just trying to be artsy and intellectual and experimental, but it really just fails as a means of entertainment. This game was honestly just a disappointing waste of time, and I see nothing of value in this experience. Dinner Date can suck a dick. Painkiller, however, is pretty damn enjoyable. Fun! Thrilling! Like any video game (or "interactive art") should be.


If you ever find yourself stuck in the perplexing dilemma of deciding whether to get Painkiller or Dinner Date, this is me telling you to get Painkiller.
items.text_zh:
以下段落是我对《Painkiller: Black Edition》的推荐，因为不知为何，Steam 认为我没有拥有那款游戏，尽管我他妈明明有。就像，我明明在商店页面上，它甚至没有那个带“立即游玩”按钮的绿色区域。搞什么鬼。它就在我的库里。我是花钱买的这东西。说真的，搞什么鬼。

《Painkiller》是一款有缺陷的游戏，但它也他妈好玩得要命。如果你喜欢像《Serious Sam》、《Doom》或《Quake》这样快节奏的 FPS，你会喜欢这款游戏的。超大的关卡，种类繁多，独特的敌人和那种特别的恐怖风格。还有独特的枪械，而且全都有副开火模式，比如一把能冻住敌人的霰弹枪，或者某种电击火焰喷射器……电击喷射器……能射出圆锯刀片手里剑之类的东西！而且你可以同时按两个键来射出一枚手里剑，它会粘在发射的位置，同时带电，电击周围多个敌人。还有一把榴弹发射器，同时也是把迷你枪。太爽了。《Painkiller》有时候会蠢难蠢难的，荒唐至极，但就是好玩得上瘾。如果对你来说太难了，你反正可以用秘籍。有时候那样也更好玩，就是疯狂杀戮，像没有明天一样狂轰滥炸。游戏还有某种……剧情。还有一个袒胸露乳的妞。别买重制版《Painkiller: Hell and Damnation》，因为他们给那个袒胸露乳的妞穿上衣服了。去他妈的。0/10。在所有值得玩的《Painkiller》里，这里的原版大概应该是你的首选。



以下段落是对《Dinner Date》的反推荐，这是一款烂游戏，我倒是能给它写推荐，但它一点都不值得推荐。

《Dinner Date》是一坨无聊的狗屎。它几乎毫无互动性，而仅有的一点点玩家输入的可能性也他妈烂透了、毫无意义；你所能做的就是朝特定方向看，让你那双丑陋的、看起来像自闭症的手稍微碰碰东西。然后有一段你的角色居然从该死的座位上站起来了，但之后还是很无聊，还是除了听这家伙对你根本不在乎的蠢事发牢骚之外无事可做。作为玩家你其实什么都做不了，因为你扮演的是角色的潜意识。哦哦哦哦……有趣的概念，但结果发现一点都不好玩。你的角色被放了鸽子，约会泡汤了，他独自坐在自家餐桌旁，而你能做的就只有听这家伙哀嚎、沉溺在自己的可悲之中。有趣的想法，糟糕的游戏。如果你想把它称为“互动艺术”而不是正经的“电子游戏”，那它在这方面也不及格。而且画面也烂。老实说，我本来很期待这款游戏，因为它是个迷人的点子，但这游戏就是烂。老实说就是烂。这是一款烂游戏，不值得花任何时间或金钱，也许除了当作一个“如何不该做游戏”的反面教材。

《Dinner Date》在其商店页面上的头号特色功能是这样写的：“朱利安的故事长达整整 25 分钟的全语音内容，通过各种独特的动画讲述，设定在实时 3D 环境中，并拥有扮演潜意识这一独一无二的交互界面，此类首创。”

整整 25 分钟？整整 25 分钟？！整整 25 分钟？！整整 25 分钟啊，老兄！整整 25 分钟的狗屎。然后你会把那玩意儿冲进马桶忘掉。或者至少试着忘掉，因为那真是相当
创伤般地恶心又痛苦，像吃屎一样难受。

这个推荐的图标显示的是《Dinner Date》的图标，但这实际上是对《Painkiller》的推荐，同时也是给任何可能真的考虑购买《Dinner Date》的人的一句警告。别买；《Dinner Date》一点都不好玩。它只是想装作文艺、有思想、有实验性，但作为娱乐手段，它真的彻底失败了。老实说，这游戏只是令人失望地浪费时间，我在这段体验里看不到任何价值。《Dinner Date》可以去吃屌。然而，《Painkiller》却相当他妈的令人享受。好玩！刺激！就像任何电子游戏（或“互动艺术”）本该有的那样。


如果你曾经陷入那种令人困惑的两难境地，不知道该买《Painkiller》还是《Dinner Date》，这就是我在告诉你，买《Painkiller》。
